messages:
Kate L: Quick sync — after yesterday's vuln triage we should revisit SIEM export retention and who can request exports. Sandbox tenants leaked a stack trace that contained user identifiers.
Jason H: Oof. What retention window was that export using?
Kate L: The subscription was set to 90 days. SOC wants 365 for security signals, but legal flagged the PII exposure.
Priya S: Two threads: 1) tighten retention for non-prod to 30d unless explicitly approved; 2) gate exports with stricter RBAC + KMS wrapping for any full-raw export.
Dan R: Agreed. We can reuse the ephemeral key-unwrap flow we discussed for forensic snapshots. For exports we add a new role export/unwrap-role that requires an approval ticket and SSO step.
Priya S: +1. Also recommend we inject a redaction transform in the export pipeline for fields marked as pii in the schema registry. That way partial exports are safe by default.
Maria V: Legal needs to sign off on the exact fields to mask. I'll loop them in but we should design the default to err on the safe side.
Jason H: Cost concern — larger retention -> higher SIEM storage costs. For security signals we can compact older raw events into tokenized summaries after 60d. Keep full detail only for approved cases.
Kate L: For incident response, oncall needs a fast path to request full data. Proposal: a timeboxed elevation (max 2 hours) that creates a scoped CMK unwrap permission and logs the approver and reason.
Dan R: Implementation sketch:
```json
{
  "Statement": [
    {"Effect":"Allow","Action":"kms:Decrypt","Resource":"arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/EXPORT-UNWRAP","Condition": {"StringEquals": {"aws:PrincipalTag/approval_ticket":"SEC-4321"},"DateLessThan":{"aws:CurrentTime":"2024-06-01T14:00:00Z"}}}
  ]
}
```
This would be minted by the approval service and auto-revoke.
security-bot: Created SEC-4321 (RBAC + export gating) and attached a checklist: https://rwd.internal/SEC-4321/checklist :lock: 
Priya S: We should add an audit hook that records: requester, approver, reason, ticket id, KMS key id, and export hash. Tie that to the long-term audit store (immutable).
Kate L: Agreed. Also add an alert if >1 export per tenant per 24h that includes pii fields.
Maria V: One more: ensure dev tools (devbox, local debug exports) cannot export raw logs by default. Make an explicit dev-export role that strips pii and reduces retention.
Jason H: I'll scope the RBAC changes and open a PR with the policy diffs. Expect a draft by EOD.
Dan R: I'll prototype the approval service changes + token minting. Putting a short runbook here: https://rwd.internal/runbooks/export-approval-v2
Kate L: Thanks — once PRs are up, let's schedule a 15m review with Legal and SOC. Want to move fast on this one. :thumbsup:
security-bot: Note: This thread has been linked to incident INC-7890 for postmortem tracking.
